name: jev-ultrafast-mcp
description: Hand a whole browser task off in one call: a server-side decision model drives the page.
long_description:
An MCP server that drives the page for your agent instead of making the agent do the driving.

A browser task goes over whole -- the URL, the goal, and the check that proves it -- and the loop runs on the server. One tool call instead of twenty. The page never enters your agent's context, and nothing is sent as a screenshot: the server reads a ref-based element table and acts on refs from it.

It never invents a target. It picks from what the page actually has, and refuses with a reason rather than guessing. `browser_open`, `browser_observe` and `browser_assert` are direct, free and keyless, so reading a page stays cheap; the handoff is for work that changes the page.

Speaks the Chrome DevTools Protocol to the Chrome you already have. No Playwright, no Selenium, no browser harness.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL in its own tab and return the element table.

tools.name: browser_observe
tools.description: Re-read the page: a delta by default, or the full element table on demand.

tools.name: browser_act
tools.description: Run a list of ops in one round trip, then return a delta.

tools.name: browser_assert
tools.description: Deterministic checks on the page, with no model judgement about whether it worked.

tools.name: browser_macro
tools.description: Record a flow once, then replay it with zero model calls.

tools.name: browser_goal
tools.description: Hand the whole task over: a decision model drives the page to the end server-side, and code checks the result.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, open, switch and close tabs.

tools.name: browser_doctor
tools.description: Self-check: which browser was found, and whether it is reachable.

typesafe_api_key.title: Decision-model key (Jev)
typesafe_api_key.description: Only needed for browser_goal. Every other tool works without a key. Leave blank to keep the reading tools keyless.

openrouter_api_key.title: Decision-model key (OpenRouter)
openrouter_api_key.description: Alternative to the above. Setting this selects the OpenRouter provider, which also needs TEXT_MODEL set to an OpenRouter slug such as deepseek/deepseek-chat.
